what_it_does: Protects a car against own damage and provides mandatory third-party liability cover.
coverage: Own damage due to accident (collision, overturning, etc.)
Fire, explosion, self-ignition and lightning damage
Theft or total loss of the vehicle
Damage due to natural calamities such as flood, cyclone, storm and earthquake
Damage due to man-made incidents such as riots, strikes, malicious acts and terrorism (as per policy terms)
Third-party liability for bodily injury, death and property damage (as per Motor Vehicles Act)
Cashless repairs at authorized network garages
Roadside assistance (towing, on-site repair, fuel delivery, etc., if opted)
add_ons: Zero depreciation cover (no deduction for depreciation on parts during claim)
Return to invoice (RTI) cover for total loss/theft
Tyre and rim protection (in some variants)
Personal accident cover for owner-driver and optional for passengers
premium_depends_on: IDV (Insured Declared Value) of the car
Car make, model, fuel type and variant
Previous claim history and NCB level
Usage type (private vs commercial) where applicable

insurer_metrics_notes.claim_settlement_ratio_trend: Health/general CSR typically in an approximate 85–97% range depending on product and year (indicative).
insurer_metrics_notes.garage_network: Large network of authorized garages for cashless repairs across India.
insurer_metrics_notes.notes: Strong digital purchase and claim intimation process, app-based status tracking and support.

best_for: Car owners who want a comprehensive private-insurer package with multiple add-on choices
Users who prefer cashless repairs and digital-first claim handling

what_it_does: Protects eligible gadgets (smartphones, laptops, tablets, etc.) against accidental damage and theft.
coverage: Accidental physical damage to the device (e.g., screen cracks, drops, liquid spills) as per policy terms
Repair or replacement of the device up to the sum insured or invoice value (after deductibles)
Loss or theft of the device due to burglary, robbery or snatching (subject to police FIR and investigation)
Worldwide protection for specified devices during travel
No-cost pick-up and drop service for repairs where service network is available
key_checks_before_buying: Maximum age of the device at the time of purchase (e.g., usually new or within a few months)
Original purchase invoice and proof-of-ownership requirements
Whether data loss, software issues and unauthorized repairs are excluded
Excess/deductible amount per claim (how much the customer must pay from pocket)
Number of claims allowed per year and any claim amount caps
Exclusions for intentional damage, cosmetic damage or unreported theft
Fraud checks, IMEI/device registration requirements and claim documentation needed
best_for: Users buying expensive smartphones, laptops or tablets who want protection against accidental damage and theft
Frequent travellers who need worldwide protection for work or personal devices
